t: Beyond Spam: LLMs as Coders, Translators, and Workflow Partners
s: This article explores LLM capabilities beyond spam generation, highlighting their use in coding, translation, and workflow integration. It contrasts LLMs' ephemeral nature with continuous learning ML systems and discusses their role in human-AI collaboration for Pipulate Workflows.
sub: LLMs as coding and translation tools, distinct from spam generation.
Ephemeral nature of LLM instances and security implications.
Pipulate Workflows and human-AI collaboration in linear processes.
Comparison of LLMs with continuous learning ML systems (e.g., River).
